front: How effective was the bombing of Germany?
back: It diverted German resources and wrecked oil and transport in 1944-45, but production rose until late 1944 and morale did not break.

front: How effective was the French Resistance?
back: Most effective in 1944 (intelligence and sabotage for D-Day, Paris rising); limited before 1943 and dependent on Allied armies.
